rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An OpenAPI document search and query server that loads API specifications from URLs and provides comprehensive tools for exploring endpoints, schemas, and authentication configurations. Built with a clean modular architecture using FastMCP, it features in-memory storage, operation indexing for fast lookups, and automatic reference resolution for schema definitions. The server offers 11 specialized tools including endpoint searching by keyword/method/tag, path documentation retrieval, schema exploration, and authentication info extraction, making it useful for API developers, integrators, and documentation teams who need to quickly understand and work with OpenAPI specifications without manually parsing complex JSON/YAML files.
